threatAlerts.title: Active XZ Utils Backdoor Variant Detected in Linux Repositories
threatAlerts.description: Sophisticated malicious payload injection targeting sshd authentication via liblzma. Allows unauthenticated remote code execution with root privileges.
threatAlerts.mitigation: Downgrade xz-utils to version 5.4.x immediately or deploy memory integrity protection rules.

threatAlerts.title: LockBit 3.0 Ransomware Campaign Targeting Financial Institutions
threatAlerts.description: Phishing lures containing weaponized ISO files extracting Group Policy Object passwords to spread ransomware domain-wide within 3 hours.
threatAlerts.mitigation: Block external ISO mount capabilities via Windows GPO; isolate compromised AD Domain Controllers.

threatAlerts.title: Volt Typhoon Zero-Day Exploitation of Edge Networking Routers
threatAlerts.description: Living-off-the-land (LotL) tactics targeting SOHO routers to establish persistent encrypted proxies into critical grid networks.
threatAlerts.mitigation: Enforce multi-factor authentication on all administrative web interfaces; rotate SSH host keys.

threatAlerts.title: Massive Spear-Phishing Surge Impersonating Microsoft 365 OAuth Apps
threatAlerts.description: Adversary-in-the-Middle (AiTM) phishing proxies bypassing standard FIDO2 authentication via malicious consent grants.
threatAlerts.mitigation: Revoke unverified OAuth app consent privileges and enforce Conditional Access App Control policies.

vulnerabilities.title: XZ Utils LZMA Decompressor Backdoor
vulnerabilities.description: Malicious code added to xz tarballs during build process that intercepts RSA public key decryption in OpenSSH daemon.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Downgrade xz-utils package to 5.4.6 or rebuild OpenSSH against clean liblzma.

vulnerabilities.title: runC Container Breakout Vulnerability (leaky vessels)
vulnerabilities.description: Process file descriptor leak allowing malicious container image to gain host filesystem write access.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade runc to version 1.1.12+ across all Kubernetes nodes and Docker engines.

threatActors.name: APT29 (Cozy Bear / Midnight Blizzard)
threatActors.targetedSectors: Government, Defense, IT Supply Chain, Think Tanks
threatActors.activeCampaigns: SolarWinds Supply Chain, M365 Password Spraying, XZ Utils Compromise
